unami-legal-force-contract.original/full: Resolution 2682 (2023) extended the UNAMI mandate to 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report on UNAMI responsibilities every four months and conduct an independent strategic review by 31 March 2024, consulting Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society, and Kuwait. Iraq's Government expressed support for the review in a letter dated 18 May 2023.
unami-legal-force-contract.original/recurring_and_review: Resolution 2682 (2023) adopted unanimously on 30 May 2023. The Secretary-General is requested to report to the Council on UNAMI responsibilities every four months and to conduct an independent strategic review of UNAMI no later than 31 March 2024. The responsible institution is the Council, the recipient is the Secretary-General, and timing is every four months and by 31 March 2024.
unami-legal-force-contract.original/review_only: Resolution 2682 (2023), adopted unanimously on 30 May 2023, mandates the Secretary-General to conduct an independent strategic review of UNAMI. This review must be completed and submitted to the Council no later than 31 March 2024. The responsible institution is the Secretary-General, and the recipient is the Council.
unami-legal-force-contract.separate/full: The Council extended the UNAMI mandate until 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report on UNAMI fulfilment every four months and to conduct an independent strategic review by 31 March 2024. This review must consult Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society, and Kuwait. Iraq's Government expressed support for the review in a letter dated 18 May 2023.
unami-legal-force-contract.separate/recurring_and_review: Resolution 2682, para. 5, requested the Secretary-General to report to the Council on UNAMI fulfilment every four months. Resolution 2682, para. 3, requested the Secretary-General to conduct and provide an independent strategic review of UNAMI no later than 31 March 2024.
unami-legal-force-contract.separate/review_only: The Secretary-General was requested to conduct and provide the Council with an independent strategic review of UNAMI no later than 31 March 2024.
